claims.text: The login attempts from n219076184117.netvigator.com and 60.30.224.116 exhibit distinct patterns in terms of timing and target accounts.

The attempts from n219076184117.netvigator.com occurred in a short burst on June 22, with 23 authentication failures recorded within a span of approximately 54 seconds, all targeting the root account.

In contrast, the attempts from 60.30.224.116 were spread across two days, June 30 and July 1, with a cluster of failures on June 30 at 19:03, followed by another set of failures on July 1 at 00:21, also targeting the root account.
Notably, the attempts from 60.30.224.116 show a pause in activity between the two sets of failures, whereas the attempts from n219076184117.netvigator.com were more rapid and continuous.
The source that looks more anomalous is n219076184117.netvigator.com due to the high frequency and short duration of the attempts.
The root cause of these anomalies is that these errors recur without any corrective action in between, indicating a potential ongoing issue with unauthorized access attempts to the system.
